//: Pinned Freenet binaries bundled into PUF-AM. Committed; the binaries themselves are not (see vendor/README.md).
//pin: freenet and fdev MUST come from the same release tag: the pack-contract code hash and the fdev PUT path are both version-sensitive. Bumping this file means re-running scripts/verify-pack-contract.mjs.
//source: Checksums transcribed from the release's own SHA256SUMS.txt; extracted-binary checksums computed from those archives.

toolVersions.//: Reported by `--version`. fdev carries its own version line, hence the mismatch with the release tag.

license.//: freenet-core is AGPL-3.0. LICENSE.md states that distributing the unmodified binary alongside an app that talks to it over WebSocket does not make that app a derivative work — which is exactly what PUF-AM does. The text still ships next to the binaries.

packContract.//: Bundled pack-contract WASM. codeHashB58 must equal PACK_CONTRACT_CODE_HASH_B58 in units/mist-freenet/src/freenet02-pack.ts — a drift there silently changes every published mist URI.

slotContract.//: Join-slot contract, built from units/mist-freenet/contracts/slot-contract (ours, not upstream). codeHashB58 must equal SLOT_CONTRACT_CODE_HASH_B58 in units/mist-freenet/src/freenet02-slot.ts.
slotContract.//address: Every slot address is BLAKE3(codeHash || slotId || farmVerifyingKey). Re-pinning this hash moves every slot, so a ticket minted before the bump stops resolving over Freenet. Bump it only with a plan for the tickets in the field.
slotContract.//rebuild: npm run mist:build:slot — needs cargo + wasm32-unknown-unknown + fdev. Reproducible on one machine with one toolchain; a different rustc will land a different hash, which is why the artifact is committed rather than built during packaging.

builtWith.//: Recorded so a hash mismatch can be told apart from a toolchain drift.

linux-x64.//: musl builds: statically linked, so they run on Fedora without matching a host glibc.

win-x64.//: Checksums pinned from the same release. Not yet launched on a Windows host — that lands with the NSIS build in Phase 3.
